name: Nestlé Beverage Factory & DC - Glendale AZ (Waddell)

fieldNotes.imageryLimitation: This is a newly-opened facility - the $675M Nestlé greenfield beverage factory + distribution center, which celebrated its opening on 28 January 2025. The only satellite imagery currently available (Maxar) shows the site MID-CONSTRUCTION: the building roof is still being installed (steel framing and blue under-construction roof sections visible) and the surrounding yard is raw graded dirt with construction laydown. Street View panos are from 2019-2021, pre-construction (empty desert). The building footprint and broad parcel are confirmed, but the operational truck-yard configuration (gate, guard booth, dock count, drop-yard layout, lane counts, staging) CANNOT be reliably read from construction-phase imagery. Most classification fields are best-effort inferences from the facility type, scale and modern-build status, and are flagged uncertain. Confidence: low. Recommend re-audit when post-2025 operational imagery is available.
fieldNotes.locating: Roster coords (33.558619, -112.384378, RANGE_INTERPOLATED, moved 47m) were accurate to within ~150m. Web research confirmed the address 8531 N 150th Ave, Waddell AZ; the large building under construction in Maxar imagery matches the 630,000 sq ft Nestlé beverage factory + DC ($675M, 300-350 jobs, Coffee mate / natural bliss / Starbucks creamers). Locked center 33.55520, -112.38120.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Inferred true - a brand-new (2024-25) modern food-grade Nestlé beverage factory + distribution center will have a controlled, guarded truck gate. Not visible in construction imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Not determinable from construction imagery; conservatively false with remoteGs true. Uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Inferred 25-50 band for a 630,000 sq ft combined factory + DC; dock-door positioning is partly visible on the south building face but not countable in construction imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Inferred 25-50 - the south portion of the parcel is allocated as truck/trailer yard but was still raw dirt when imaged; dropYard true inferred.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur evident in the site grading; truck-served only.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Open desert / former agricultural land in Waddell, SW of metro Glendale, with a golf course adjacent - edge-of-metro; per rubric classified Rural.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Greenfield site with abundant paved width - room for express/bypass lanes; inferred true.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the graded perimeter box (~960m N-S x ~640m E-W) ~ 110 acres of parcel; the active operational footprint is smaller.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single large multi-section factory + DC building.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Zero trailers in the operational sense - imagery predates operations.
